QuestInfo.name: Sweeping the Enemy Base
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# has something more to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat 100 or more #o2400007# monsters at the enemy hideout and return. The enemy hideout can be entered through the hidden entrance at #m400010300#. When you're done, return to #p3000000# at #m400000000#.
QuestInfo.2: You have swept the enemy base.

0.0: Kaiser, while you're searching for the Relic, try to take out as many enemies as possible. We'll be there too, but every enemy we deal with now is one we won't have to fight later.

yes.0: Go to the enemy base and defeat 100 #o2400007# enemies. We will take care of the rest. Get in through the hidden entrance at #m400010300#.
yes.1: Please come talk to me after you complete the mission.

no.0: Reclaiming the Relic does not eliminate the root of the problem. We need to flush out the Nefarious Priests!

1.0: Well done. It seems like there are still few remnants left, but they will be cleared soon.

mob.0: Even after you ransacked the place, the enemy keeps reinforcing their base! Return and defeat about 100 #o2400007#  enemies. Remember the hidden entrance at #m400010300#.
